syllabus_topics: Introduction to thermal processing technologies for metallic materials.
Fundamentals of thermal processing of materials applied to casting. Flow of liquid metals. Heat transfer applied to casting. Thermal stresses and strains.
Melting, pouring, solidification and cooling of metals in casting. Metallurgical properties.
Lost mold and permanent mold casting processes. Gravity and pressure filling. Heat transfer in insulating and conductive molds. Feeding system.
Fundamentals of thermal processing of materials applied to welding. Heat sources, energy density, and thermal input. Heat transfer, solidification, and metallurgical properties. Residual stresses.
Electric arc, resistance, and high power density welding processes (laser and electron beam). Solid-state welding: friction and diffusion.
Quality, inspection, design considerations, and production costs.

assessment_methods.method: Group project analyzing the manufacturing sequence of metallic components

assessment_rules: For the normal period, the minimum exam grade is 8.0 out of 20 and the minimum project grade is 9.5 out of 20. Laboratory grades are based on the best 5 out of 6 labs, with participation in at least 5 labs equating to 100% of the lab grade, otherwise 0%. For the special period, the assessment consists of a 50% exam and 50% project, with the same minimum grades for the exam and project. Students who did not complete the project during the normal period must prepare one, individually or in groups of up to 4 elements, starting 6 weeks before the special period exam and submitting two days before it.
